description: Loewe sham combination — the same drug combined with itself. Loewe CI must read ~1.0 at every valid cell. The strictest correctness check for the combination index: any non-trivial deviation indicates a bug in either the generator or the loewe_ci pipeline. Both axes share identical Hill parameters and direction; hill = 1.0 keeps Loewe rigorously defined (the formula assumes equal slopes for sham combinations).
